signal_hypotheses.feature: Predictive power of prior volatility or stock-specific momentum on watch-list failure rate
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Logistic regression using stock's historical vol, momentum, and sector strength to predict STOPPED vs CLEAN_LIFTOFF outcomes
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Higher volatility and negative momentum should increase failure probability
